content: Quassia is an over-the-counter (OTC) cream that has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of head lice, pubic lice (commonly referred to as crab lice), and body lice. Common side effects associated with its use include irritation of the eyes, skin, or scalp. Adult Indications and Dosage FDA-Labeled Indications and Dosage (Adults) Indications: Quassia is indicated for the treatment of head lice, pubic lice, and body lice. Dosage: This product is suitable for adults and children aged six months and older. Apply the entire contents of one tube to dry hair, starting from behind the ears and working toward the back of the neck, then forward. Ensure thorough application to saturate the hair and scalp, as all lice and eggs must come into contact with the product for it to be effective. For individuals with long or very thick hair, two tubes may be required. Use the supplied shower cap to keep the hair damp. Leave the product on for four hours before washing. In cases of severe infestation, remove the shower cap after four hours and leave the product on overnight. Wash the treated area thoroughly with warm water and regular shampoo. Towel-dry the hair and comb out tangles using a regular comb or brush. Optionally, remove any remaining lice or nits using the included nit comb or fingernails. If the hair dries during combing, slightly dampen it with water. Off-Label Use and Dosage (Adults) There is limited information available regarding off-label guideline-supported or non-guideline-supported use of Quassia in adult patients. Pediatric Indications and Dosage FDA-Labeled Indications and Dosage (Pediatrics) Dosage: Quassia is approved for use in children aged six months and older. The application instructions are the same as for adults, ensuring thorough saturation of the hair and scalp for effective treatment. Off-Label Use and Dosage (Pediatrics) There is limited information available regarding off-label guideline-supported or non-guideline-supported use of Quassia in pediatric patients. Contraindications There is limited information regarding specific contraindications for Quassia in the drug label. Warnings Quassia is for external use only. Avoid application near the eyes, inside the nose, mouth, or vagina, and on lice present in the eyebrows or eyelashes. If lice are found in these areas, consult a doctor. Keep the product tightly closed and protect the eyes with a washcloth or towel during application. If the product comes into contact with the eyes, flush them immediately with water. Discontinue use and seek medical advice if eye irritation occurs, if skin or scalp irritation persists, or if an infection develops. If the product is swallowed, seek medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. Adverse Reactions Clinical Trials Experience Reported adverse reactions include eye irritation and skin or scalp irritation. Labor and Delivery: No FDA guidance is available on the use of Quassia during labor and delivery. Nursing Mothers: No FDA guidance is available on the use of Quassia in nursing mothers. Pediatric Use: No additional FDA guidance is available beyond the labeled indications. Geriatric Use: No FDA guidance is available on the use of Quassia in geriatric patients. Gender and Race: No specific FDA guidance is available regarding the use of Quassia in specific gender or racial populations. Renal and Hepatic Impairment: No FDA guidance is available on the use of Quassia in patients with renal or hepatic impairment. Females of Reproductive Potential and Males: No FDA guidance is available for these populations. Immunocompromised Patients: No FDA guidance is available for immunocompromised patients. Administration and Monitoring Administration: Quassia is applied topically. Monitoring: There is limited information available regarding monitoring requirements for Quassia. IV Compatibility There is no information available regarding IV compatibility for Quassia, as it is not intended for intravenous use. Overdosage There is limited information available regarding overdosage of Quassia. Pharmacology Mechanism of Action There is limited information available regarding the mechanism of action of Quassia. Structure Active Ingredients: Quassia amara 2X HPUS (Amargo 200 mcg/g). Inactive Ingredients: Aqua, cetearyl alcohol, dimethicone, fragrance, cetrimonium bromide, citric acid. Pharmacodynamics and Pharmacokinetics There is limited information available regarding the pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics of Quassia. Nonclinical Toxicology There is limited information available regarding the nonclinical toxicology of Quassia. Clinical Studies There is limited information available regarding clinical studies of Quassia. How Supplied Quassia is supplied in 0.3 FL OZ (60 mL) tubes. It is marketed under the brand name Quit Nits Advance® and is designed to kill head lice and eggs with a single application. Precautions with Alcohol The interaction between alcohol and Quassia has not been established. Patients should consult their doctor regarding the effects of consuming alcohol while using this medication. Brand Names Quassia is marketed under the brand name Quit Nits Advance®.
